lookup.rule: For each fired signature (in checker order), try '<category>:<SIGNATURE>' for each detected category in priority order, then '*:<SIGNATURE>'. Append at most 2 'Principle:' lines per feedback, most specific first, no duplicate text. No hit means no hint.
lookup.log: Record matched keys per round in the jsonl as kb_hits.

provenance: Written by Claude in a chat that had already seen the LFSR and sequence-generator problems. The lfsr:* and sequence_gen:* entries are therefore not 'untuned'; exclude them (--exclude-categories lfsr,sequence_gen) for any run claiming the cache was written without seeing the problem.

categories.name: combinational
categories.rule: also applies when the design has no clock port

PORT_MISMATCH.detect: compile error names an unknown module or port, or port width differs from the testbench

WIDTH_MISMATCH.detect: iverilog -Wall reports a width/padding warning in the DUT

IMPLICIT_NET.detect: iverilog -Wall reports an implicit net declaration in the DUT

MULTIPLE_DRIVERS.detect: an output is written in more than one block

BLOCKING_IN_CLOCKED_LOGIC.detect: a clocked block writes a register with an immediate update

NONBLOCKING_IN_COMB_LOGIC.detect: a block with no edge in its trigger list uses deferred updates

INCOMPLETE_SENSITIVITY.detect: a combinational block's explicit trigger list omits a signal it reads (wildcard lists are fine)

LATCH_INFERRED.detect: a combinational block writes a signal on some branches but not all, with no prior default

INIT_ONLY_VALUE.detect: a simulation-start block writes a design output

UNSYNTHESIZABLE_CONSTRUCT.detect: the DUT contains # delays, wait statements, or file/display system tasks

COMB_LOOP.detect: simulation stalls at a fixed time with no stimulus progress

UNUSED_INPUT.detect: an input port name is never read in the DUT body

UNDRIVEN_OUTPUT.detect: an output port is never written, or reads Z in simulation

X_BEFORE_FIRST_EDGE.detect: output is X with reset asserted and no clock edge yet

WRONG_BETWEEN_EDGES_IN_RESET.detect: reset asserted mid-run; output not at reset value before the next edge (only when async reset is required)

WRONG_AFTER_EDGE_IN_RESET.detect: reset held across an edge; output not at reset value afterwards

RESET_POLARITY_INVERTED.detect: output reaches the reset value only while reset is deasserted

PARTIAL_RESET.detect: output correct during reset but X on the first cycle after release

WRONG_AFTER_RESET_RELEASE.detect: first divergence is the first edge after a mid-run reset release

NEXT_STATE_WRONG_FIRST_EDGE.detect: first edge after reset release diverges

NEXT_STATE_DIVERGES_LATER.detect: correct for some cycles, then diverges

PARTIAL_X.detect: some output bits X, others defined

OUTPUT_STUCK.detect: output constant over many cycles where the reference changes

OUTPUT_INVERTED.detect: output equals bitwise inverse of expected

BIT_ORDER_REVERSED.detect: output equals expected with bit order reversed

SHIFTED_TOWARD_LSB.detect: output's upper bits equal previous state's lower bits moved down one

SHIFTED_TOWARD_MSB.detect: output's lower bits equal previous state's upper bits moved up one

OFF_BY_ONE_VALUE.detect: output equals expected plus or minus one

ONE_CYCLE_LATE.detect: output at cycle n equals expected at n-1

ONE_CYCLE_EARLY.detect: output at cycle n equals expected at n+1

UPPER_BITS_ZERO.detect: high bits always 0 where expected has ones

WRONG_WHILE_DISABLED.detect: first divergence occurs while an enable-like input is low

WRONG_AFTER_REENABLE.detect: first divergence is within 2 cycles after an enable-like input rises again

WRONG_AFTER_WRAP.detect: first divergence is the step after the reference returns to its post-reset value

WRONG_AT_TERMINAL_VALUE.detect: first divergence at the reference's maximum value

OUTPUT_GLITCH.detect: output changes mid-cycle with no clock edge or reset change

TOGGLES_EVERY_CYCLE.detect: output alternates between two values every cycle

PERIOD_WRONG.detect: output repeats with a period different from the reference's

COMB_WRONG_FOR_SOME_INPUTS.detect: combinational design: some input vectors mismatch, others match

COMB_DEPENDS_ON_HISTORY.detect: same input vector applied twice gives different outputs

SIGNEDNESS_WRONG.detect: mismatches only when an operand's top bit is set

OVERFLOW_UNHANDLED.detect: mismatches only when the true result exceeds the output width

CARRY_WRONG.detect: carry/borrow output differs while the sum bits match

FLAG_WRONG.detect: a status-flag output differs while the data output matches

VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE.detect: output value outside the set the reference ever produces

DISTRIBUTION_SKEWED.detect: over many samples, value frequencies differ beyond tolerance

DIGIT_OUT_OF_RANGE.detect: a 4-bit digit field of the output exceeds 9

FSM_ILLEGAL_STATE.detect: output becomes X or constant after a specific input sequence

FSM_MISSED_TRANSITION.detect: divergence follows an input combination not seen earlier in the run

FSM_OUTPUT_TIMING.detect: outputs match a one-cycle shift of the reference only around input changes

FSM_NO_RECOVERY.detect: after a completed operation the output never matches again

DETECT_MISSES_OVERLAP.detect: reference asserts on an overlapping match where the DUT does not

DETECT_FALSE_POSITIVE.detect: DUT asserts a detect output where the reference does not

PULSE_WIDTH_WRONG.detect: high pulse length differs from the reference's

DUTY_CYCLE_WRONG.detect: high fraction per period differs from the reference's

DWELL_TIME_WRONG.detect: time spent in an output state differs from the reference's

EDGE_DETECT_DOUBLE_PULSE.detect: DUT pulse lasts more than one cycle or repeats for one input change

BIT_PERIOD_WRONG.detect: UART monitor: measured bit width outside tolerance of clk/baud

NO_START_BIT.detect: UART monitor: data appears without a preceding low start bit

STOP_BIT_MISSING.detect: UART monitor: line not high at the stop-bit sample point

BYTE_BIT_ORDER_REVERSED.detect: decoded byte equals expected with bits reversed

BYTE_SHIFTED_ONE_BIT.detect: decoded byte equals expected shifted by one bit

PARITY_WRONG.detect: parity bit inconsistent with data bits

IDLE_LEVEL_WRONG.detect: serial line not at idle level between frames or after reset

SAMPLING_POINT_WRONG.detect: RX decodes correctly at nominal baud but fails with small baud offsets

FRAMING_ACCEPTED_BAD.detect: RX reports a byte as valid for a frame with a low stop bit

BUSY_FLAG_WRONG.detect: busy/ready output disagrees with whether a frame is in flight

SPI_MODE_WRONG.detect: SPI monitor decodes correctly only under a different CPOL/CPHA

CHIP_SELECT_WRONG.detect: select deasserted mid-word, or never asserted during clocking

I2C_START_STOP_WRONG.detect: SDA changes while SCL is high outside start/stop

I2C_ACK_WRONG.detect: ninth-clock SDA level wrong for the expected ack/nack

OPEN_DRAIN_VIOLATED.detect: DUT drives 1 (not Z) on an open-drain line

HANDSHAKE_VIOLATED.detect: beats counted on cycles without valid and ready both high

DATA_UNSTABLE_WHILE_VALID.detect: data or valid changes while valid=1 and ready=0

VALID_DEPENDS_ON_READY.detect: valid never rises while ready is held low

FIFO_FLAG_WRONG.detect: full/empty differs from a model occupancy count

OVERFLOW_ACCEPTED.detect: a write while full changes stored data or count

UNDERFLOW_ACCEPTED.detect: a read while empty changes count or returns data flagged valid

FIFO_ORDER_WRONG.detect: read data order differs from write order

FIFO_COUNT_WRONG.detect: count output differs from model occupancy

READ_LATENCY_WRONG.detect: read data matches the reference shifted by one cycle

READ_DURING_WRITE_WRONG.detect: mismatch only when read and write address match in one cycle

WRITE_ENABLE_IGNORED.detect: contents change on a cycle with write enable low

BYTE_ENABLE_WRONG.detect: a lane with its byte enable low changed

GRANT_NOT_ONEHOT.detect: more than one grant bit high, or a grant to a non-requester

STARVATION.detect: a continuously requesting input not granted within N cycles

CDC_UNSYNCHRONIZED.detect: a signal from one clock domain read by logic clocked by another without two stages

GRAY_CODE_VIOLATED.detect: a cross-domain pointer changes more than one bit per step
